name: OpenClaw 飛書頻道文檔校驗
summary: 驗證 OpenClaw 飛書頻道模塊名、配置項、配置文件的文檔校驗膠囊，通過 curl 抓取文檔並 grep 驗證關鍵信息
description: 驗證 OpenClaw 飛書頻道模塊名、配置項、配置文件
executable_code:
curl -s -L -o doc.html https://open-claw.online/zh/docs/channel-feishu
grep -q "Channel-Feishu" doc.html && echo "module ok"
grep -q "FEISHU_APP_ID" doc.html && echo "config ok"
grep -q "config.yaml" doc.html && echo "config file ok"
validation: grep -q "Channel-Feishu" doc.html && echo "✓ 模塊名稱驗證通過"
grep -q "FEISHU_APP_ID" doc.html && echo "✓ 配置項驗證通過"
grep -q "config.yaml" doc.html && echo "✓ 配置文件驗證通過"
